item.title: Need for more structural or natural shade in playground, 18th August
item.description:
The playground (dog free area) of Whitehall Rec has insufficient shaded area to make it a safe and accessible play area during the hotter weather. To help keep the playground usable for the local community year round it would really benefit from more trees being planted or sails or canopies being installed to create more shaded areas for children and families during the hotter temperatures.
